note: Canonical region registry for GTA VI. All economy, mission, POI, and collectible data references region IDs from this file. Extend post-launch as districts and sub-regions are confirmed by community mapping. 'dual-territory' terminology retired — GTA VI has multiple regions sharing one GTA$ economy.

regions.name: Vice City
regions.description: Dense urban core — skyscrapers, beach strip, nightlife, high-end retail. Highest property and commodity prices. GTA Online equivalent: Los Santos.

regions.name: Leonida Keys
regions.description: Island chain south of Vice City — marinas, fishing villages, smuggling routes. Mid-tier pricing. Strong black market economy signal.

regions.name: Port Gellhorn
regions.description: Industrial port suburb — container yards, warehouses, working-class neighbourhoods. Import/export hub. Lower property prices, strong criminal enterprise potential.

regions.name: Grassrivers
regions.description: Vast rural interior — swamps, farms, trailer parks, airstrips. Cheapest commodity prices. Smuggling, agriculture, off-grid criminal economy. GTA Online equivalent: Blaine County.

regions.name: Ambrosia
regions.description: Upscale beach resort district — luxury hotels, beach clubs, art deco architecture. Likely a sub-district of or adjacent to Vice City. Reported from press assets and Leonida Intel.

regions.name: Mount Kalaga
regions.description: Highland/mountain national park area. Likely part of the wider Leonida state. Sparse population, natural landmark.
regions.trailer_evidence: Press assets — Mount Kalaga National Park
